name: Nene
source:
The protagonist's girlfriend. High school graduate, NEET. She loves cosplaying and goes to events often. She cheated with a guy who hit on her. 

Currently, she cut all contact with the guy and devotes herself to her boyfriend in an attempt to save their relationship.
